related_questions.question: How to look up Ohio court cases?

text_blocks.snippet: To find Ohio court cases, you can utilize online resources like the Ohio Supreme Court's website and third-party websites specializing in Ohio court records. You can search by party name, case number, or specific court, depending on the record type (e.g., civil, criminal, family).

list.title: **Ohio Supreme Court's Website (supremecourt.ohio.gov)
list.snippet: This official website provides access to information on the Supreme Court, including its docket, opinions, and other resources.

list.title: **County and Court Websites
list.snippet: Many individual Ohio counties and courts offer their own online portals for accessing court records.

list.title: **OhioCourtRecords.us
list.snippet: This third-party website aggregates information from various Ohio courts and provides search capabilities for different types of records.

list.title: PACER (Public Access to Court Electronic Records):
list.snippet: For federal court cases within Ohio (Northern District of Ohio), PACER provides access to case information.

list.title: Party Name:
list.snippet: Search by the names of individuals or entities involved in the case.

list.title: Case Number:
list.snippet: If you know the specific case number, you can directly search for that case.

list.title: Court Type:
list.snippet: Specify whether you're looking for a civil, criminal, family, or other type of case.

list.title: County:
list.snippet: If searching on a county or court website, you can further narrow your search by selecting the specific county.

list.title: Date Range:
list.snippet: You can often refine your search by specifying a date range to limit the results.

list.title: Consider Third-Party Websites:
list.snippet: If you're having trouble finding records on official court websites, third-party sites like OhioCourtRecords.us may be helpful, but be sure to check the credibility of the source.

list.title: Be Specific:
list.snippet: The more details you can provide in your search (e.g., full names, case numbers, specific dates), the more accurate and efficient your search will be.

list.title: Charges May Apply:
list.snippet: Some online court records, especially those accessed through PACER, may involve fees for accessing documents or reports.
